notes.title: Grey Lucidity Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!
We thank you for your interest in Grey Lucidity.
And for all those who have been following and wishlist for our game: Thank you for your continued support and encouragement after we postponed our release date because we brought the proofread japanese language in the game. That was much appreciated.
Thanks again for all of your support!

All the best,
Miracle Gates Entertainment Team

notes.title: We apologize for the delay from the release date
notes.notes:
We apologize for the delay from the release date, the game actually is already finished 100%, but since we know that our player who visited our steam page is also much from Japan, we decided to bring Japanese language for the first release version. Now all is done, we are in the testing phase. Again, we apologize about this, and will bring the best for our players. we will release it soon on August 6, 2021, without any delay again. and if you have any request about the language, you can request it below. 

Wish you all the best from our Development Team!
